title: fix(service-knowledge): knowledge search asks the object's API exposure and the caller's field-level read rules per source
body:
Fixes #36839

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:受限用户(以及代其提问的 AI)检索知识库时,若某个知识源包含他无权查看的字段,或其对象未对接口开放、所属包已停用、是未声明 AI 可读的系统对象,该知识源对他不再返回任何结果;有权限的用户与系统任务不受影响。
- 为什么做:属于「MCP 问数」主线,在知识检索对 MCP 客户开放之前,先堵住低权限用户借 AI 读到其本无权看到的字段内容这一安全缺口。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是受限用户检索不到本该能看到的知识源(只会更严,不会更松);改动可直接回滚。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

Option D of the ruling recorded on #36650 (comment 7121194365, quoted in #36839's body): in the knowledge service, at source granularity, fail closed, no new spec key. Governing text: ADR-0090 D10 rule 1, ADR-0049.

- **Defect class / location / function.** Missing field-level and API-exposure enforcement on a row-serving door: `KnowledgeService.search` (`packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-service.ts`) re-checked an object-source hit only with a row read of its id under the caller's context, while the passage it returns is built at index time, under a system context, from every `contentFields` member, the record `title` and the source's `metadataFields`.
- **New `knowledge-source-admission.ts`**, asked by a new private `admitSources` step before any adapter is searched, for a non-system caller with a data engine bound, once per (caller, object) per search:
  1. disabled package: core's `registryObjectPackageDisabled` over the engine's registry (the predicate the data route and the analytics door ask; no injected hook needed, so no new dependency on metadata-protocol);
  2. API exposure: `canServeApiOperation(enable, 'search')` (`@objectstack/spec/data`), the decision and operation the cross-object search asks;
  3. `sys_*` objects: served only when `isAiReadExposed` answers true (`enable.aiReadable: true`), the MCP record tools' posture;
  4. field gate: every field the source serves (`contentFields`, `'*'` = every declared field; `metadataFields`; `title`), less the credential-class and `internal` fields `recordToDocument` never indexes, must be in the `security` service's `getQueryableFields` answer; absent it or `undefined`, `getReadableFields` less every `maskingRule` field; with no `security` service, every field except the `maskingRule` ones (the contract's fallback, `ISecurityService.getQueryableFields`).
  A source failing any gate is not searched for that caller. Queryable rather than readable: a passage carries the unmasked value and the search matches on it.
- **Fail closed.** A schema read, package probe or field answer that throws refuses every source over that object (logged at `error`, `warn` as fallback); a `security` service answering neither field question refuses too. The system context bypasses, as it bypasses the row re-check; the no-context and no-engine paths are unchanged (they already drop every object-source hit).
- **Wiring.** `KnowledgeServicePlugin` passes a new optional `resolveSecurity` option resolving `security` per search (plugin order free); a lookup miss reads as "no security service". `KnowledgeFieldSecurity` is exported as a type.
- **Pins and claims brought true.** `row-serving-door-exposure.pin.test.ts` now holds knowledge retrieval BY NAME (`HELD_BY_NAME`: the door imports its decision site, which asks the exposure decision and `getQueryableFields`, and the behaviour pin exists) instead of naming it unconstrained. The `mcp-http-identity` note in `authz-conformance.matrix.ts` states the knowledge-service enforcement its "RLS / FLS / tenant apply exactly as on REST /data" claim relies on once a tool serves knowledge search. `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx` §5 (new "Source admission" subsection), §7.1 and §9 state the gates and the narrowing. `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row 46 now names `admitSources` (its new system-context bypass read), with the generated register regenerated by `check-system-context-census.mjs --write`.

## Tests

- New `packages/services/service-knowledge/src/__tests__/knowledge-source-admission.test.ts` (16), through the real `KnowledgeService`, refusal and preservation per gate: a member who reads the row but not `salary_note` gets no hit from the source naming it and the adapter is never asked to search it, while a manager and the system context get it; `title` and `metadataFields` hidden each refuse; `'*'` refuses on one hidden field and does not ask about credential / `internal` fields; a masked field via the `getReadableFields` fallback; no security service ⇒ `maskingRule` fallback; a throwing field answer and an unanswering service fail closed; the answer is asked once per object; `apiEnabled: false` dropped for an end-user context and kept for the system context; an `apiMethods` whitelist without `search` refused and one with `list` admitted; a disabled package's object dropped and kept for system; a `sys_*` object without `aiReadable` dropped, with it kept; a throwing schema read fails closed; an http source is untouched. Two more drive `KnowledgeServicePlugin` on a real `LiteKernel` with a registered `security` service (refusal + preservation) and without one (fallback admits).
- **Red before / green after.** With `knowledge-service.ts` and `knowledge-service-plugin.ts` restored to the base `f77d078d` (blob match confirmed), the new file ran 14 failed / 2 passed (the 2 are pure preservation legs); restored to HEAD (blob match, `git diff HEAD` empty) it runs 16 / 16.
- `row-serving-door-exposure.pin.test.ts` (core `repo` project) 4 / 4; with `knowledge-service.ts` restored to base, the new held-by-name test is red (1 failed / 3 passed), restored blob matches HEAD.

<details><summary>Local runs on head 774652cd63 (package suite, pins, derived gates)</summary>

- Under `os-verify-lock`, VERDICT command-exit 0 (head e2a340d483, src identical at 774652cd63; the last commit touches one docs page): `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/service-knowledge^...' build`, then `@objectstack/service-knowledge` test (5 files / 65 tests), typecheck (`tsc --noEmit` + `check:test-typecheck` OK) and build (`check-dts-emitted` 2/2); core `repo` project `row-serving-door-exposure.pin.test.ts` 4 / 4.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on 774652cd63: 105 derived; all 105 run locally, each exit 0 (recorded as command plus exit code). `--ran`: 105 derived, 105 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero), 0 UNRUN.
- A first gate pass on fb887f8d found `check:system-context-census` red on this diff's new `isSystem` read (no row owned `admitSources`); fixed in 774652cd63 and green on the final pass.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0, no anchored file in the change set.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `metadataFields` is gated beside `contentFields` and `title`: a hit's `metadata` serves those values, so leaving them out would keep the same leak; the card's Expected 2 names `contentFields` and `title`.
- `title` is required only when the object declares a `title` field (or its schema is unknown), because `recordToDocument` serves the record's `title` whatever the source names.
- A `security` service whose field answer is `undefined` on both methods refuses the source (fail closed) rather than falling to the object's own projection.
- No published accept set narrows: no spec key, value or schema changes. What narrows is runtime results for restricted callers, stated in the changeset.

## Verification

Read first, by risk: `packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-source-admission.ts` (`admitObject`, `servedFieldsOf`, `admitSourceFields`), the `admitSources` hunk in `knowledge-service.ts`, then the plugin's `resolveSecurity` wiring.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge exec vitest run src/__tests__/knowledge-source-admission.test.ts` — expect 16 passed.
